Rae (Docs): Quick thread for the relnotes I'm assembling for tomorrow's docs deploy. Focus: snippet cleanup, a stray 404 from embed-api anchor changes, and a short streaming quirk QA reported. I'll open the PR in ~10m.

Tom (SDK): paste the missing snippet IDs and paths and I'll grep the examples repo. If needed I can add temporary stubs.

Rae (Docs): two hits so far: `snippet:embed_stream_old` referenced in guides/embeddings/getting-started.md and `snippet:chat_midflow_3` referenced from tutorials/chat/continuation.md (anchor renamed). I'll include exact lines in the PR.

Yuna (I18N): FYI our zh/pt branches still point at the old anchors. I'll wait for the final anchor name so I don't have to rebase twice.

QA-Bot: New ticket #8388: embed streaming sometimes trims final token for very short prompts on canary. Attached minimal repro.

Ibrahim (Eng): Confirmed. Can reproduce with tiny batch sizes (max_tokens <=7). Root cause looks like flush ordering on current canary build; fix targeted for next micro release. Recommend Known Issue + workaround.

Sana (Docs): Proposed relnotes copy: "Known issue: short streaming sequences on canary models may omit the final token. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use stable models." Add repro steps and logs.

Tom (SDK): I'll push a small PR with TODO stub snippets so snippet-check doesn't block the relnotes PR. Mark stubs clearly.

Rae (Docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7238 - title: "Relnotes: snippet tidy, embed-api redirect, streaming note". Draft has 3 bullets, a short code repro, localization notes, and anchor `#known-issues-v1-5-0`.

QA-Bot: CI summary for PR #7238: docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 missing refs), link-check: fail (1 404).

Tom (SDK): Stub PR #7239 merged with TODO stubs. Re-running checks.

QA-Bot: All checks passing now on PR #7238.

Yuna (I18N): I'll rebase translation branches and open the i18n PR once `#known-issues-v1-5-0` is live.

Ibrahim (Eng): If QA wants a short staging window to re-run the repro against a canary snapshot, ping me and I can spin up a 20-minute slot.

Sana (Docs): Added rollback contact `#eng-oncall` and one-line rollback playbook in the relnotes. Planning to merge tomorrow 09:30 PT and post the announce after deploy.

Rae (Docs): merging in 10 unless objections. Please leave copy edits on the PR.

Tom (SDK): left a couple of nit comments; LGTM otherwise.

Yuna (I18N): good from localization.

Ibrahim (Eng): good from eng.

Rae (Docs): merged. Posting announce to #product once deploy is green. Thanks everyone! :tada:
